♦️ **FLEX GUI PRO V9.3.0 APỤTALA UGBU A! (AFTER EFFECTS)**

**MAP RIGS 2.0**, AutoCaptions nwere **Your script** na **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe**, na **Flex Studio (Beta)** nke na-ebu ụzọ budata, wee jụọ gị tupu ọ wụnye.

*(Wụnye ya n'elu ụdị gị dị ugbu a ma malitegharịa After Effects otu ugboro.)*

♦️ **Ọhụrụ: MAP RIGS 2.0**
* Nhazi **Map desk**, ịchọ ebe na-enweghị ịntanetị, **Quick looks** (Country Pop, Space Dive, Trip Route na ndị ọzọ), Stick to Map, Clean labels, Always Sharp, ụdị map n'efu na **Open in Flex Maps**.
* Ngwaọrụ mgbakwunye ya (nhazi ozugbo, ụdị, akara aha, 3D, Finalize) na-ebanye n'ezie n'ime After Effects ugbu a.

♦️ **Ihe ọhụrụ na AutoCaptions**
* **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (igwe ojii, na-eji kredit Flex AI) bụ injin a na-atụ aro, a họrọla ya otu ugboro maka onye ọ bụla. Họrọ Whisper ọzọ ka ị mepụta ederede n'efu na kọmputa gị (Translate To chọrọ Whisper). Mgbe sava nwere ọtụtụ ọrụ, ọ na-egosi ọnọdụ gị n'ahịrị.
* **Your script**: ederede na-ewere nsụpe na okwu nke script gị ebe ọ bụla i kwuru okwu ndị ahụ.
* Mwepụta **Editable template**: ederede dị ka ọkwa template ị nwere ike imezigharị n'ime Essential Properties (After Effects 2026).
* Ọ dịghị ihe a họrọ, Source media tọgbọkwa chakoo? Ọ na-enye **composition niile**. Otu ụda ahụ na-ejigharị transcript ya.

♦️ **Flex Studio (Beta)**
* **Download Flex Studio (Beta)** na-ebudata, wee jụọ **Install / Not now**.
* Ngwa ahụ (2.0.0-beta.2): ebe ọrụ **PRO, TRACK, ROTOSCOPE, COLOR GRADING**, igodo ngwaọrụ dị ka nke After Effects, clip na-emeghe ozugbo, OPEN na-arụkwa ọrụ na precomp na ọkwa adjustment.

♦️ **Edoziri**
* Mmetụta theme ndị furu efu n'ọtụtụ PC Windows alọghachila (dị mfe karịa mgbe a gbanyụrụ mmetụta animation nke Windows).

♦️ **Ebe ị nọ, nke nhọrọ, maka nchekwa licence**
* A na-ajụ ya naanị otu ugboro, ọ bụkwa nhọrọ: ọbụna na **No thanks**, ihe niile na-arụ ọrụ. Gbanwee ya na **Flex Settings > Privacy**. A na-edebe ya ọnwa 12, a naghị ere ya ma ọlị, a naghịkwa ekesa ya ma e wezụga ebe iwu chọrọ ya.

ult.message:
♦️ **FLEX ULTIMATE V2.3.0 APỤTALA UGBU A! (PREMIERE PRO)**

**Caption Stack abatala n'ime AutoCaptions** ya na ụdị maka okwu ọ bụla, nhazi, mmegharị na ụda. **UN-NEST** na blend modes na-arụ ọrụ na Premiere 26.5, **AUTO CUT** bụ naanị otu ịpị, **Flex Studio (Beta)** na-emeghekwa clip gị site na panel.

*(Wụnye ya n'elu ụdị gị dị ugbu a ma malitegharịa Premiere Pro otu ugboro.)*

♦️ **Ọhụrụ: Ederede na-emegharị ahụ na AutoCaptions**
* **Ụdị okwu**: nye okwu ọ bụla agba nke ya, font na mmecha Flat, Shine ma ọ bụ Glow.
* **Nhazi ahịrị**: Stack, Over, Under, Beside na Line.
* **Mmegharị maka okwu ọ bụla** (Fade, Pop, Rise, Type, Shake na ndị ọzọ) ya na nlele mbụ, tinyekwa ụda **Pop / Tick / Swoosh**. Ụdị okwu na mmegharị chọrọ mwepụta **Images**.
* **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (igwe ojii, na-eji kredit Flex AI) bụ ugbu a injin a na-atụ aro, a họrọla ya otu ugboro maka onye ọ bụla; họrọ injin Whisper ka ị mepụta ederede n'efu na-enweghị ịntanetị.
* **Your script** (ọnọdụ Captions): ederede na-ewere okwu nke script gị ebe i kwuru okwu ndị ahụ.
* Mgbe ọ dịghị ihe a họrọ (kaadị Source tọgbọ chakoo), ọ na-enye **timeline niile**; a na-echekwa ederede n'akụkụ project gị.

♦️ **Ọhụrụ: Flex Studio (Beta)**
* **Open in Flex Studio** na-esochi clip ahụ n'ime ngwa ahụ; **APPLY TO PREMIERE** na-eziga track ahụ azụ. Awụnyebeghị ya? **Download Flex Studio (Beta)** na-ebudata ya, wee jụọ **Install / Not now**.

♦️ **Agbanwere**
* **AUTO CUT** na-enyocha clip a họrọ ma bee ya n'otu ịpị. **Retakes** na-ejide ahịrịokwu ndị a malitegharịrị.
* **Audio Studio** nwere taabụ isii n'ime ya ugbu a. **Library** bi ugbu a n'ime Nest Saver.

♦️ **Edoziri**
* **UN-NEST** na Premiere 26.5 (ọ na-ajụ nest ọ bụla), na blend modes dị ka Screen nke na-alaghachi na Normal (Premiere n'asụsụ Bekee).
* Akara uhie **AUTOSAVE 0:00**, nlele mbụ Caption Stack gbara ọchịchịrị, na mmetụta theme furu efu n'ọtụtụ PC Windows.

♦️ **Ebe ị nọ, nke nhọrọ, maka nchekwa licence**
* A na-ajụ ya naanị otu ugboro, ọ bụkwa nhọrọ: ọbụna na **No thanks**, ihe niile na-arụ ọrụ. Gbanwee ya na **Flex Settings > Privacy**. A na-edebe ya ọnwa 12, a naghị ere ya ma ọlị, a naghịkwa ekesa ya ma e wezụga ebe iwu chọrọ ya.
